Indian Cricketer Deepti Sharma Prepares for Asia Cup via The Hundred Tournament

Indian cricketer Deepti Sharma is participating in The Hundred, a 100-ball cricket tournament in England, to enhance her skills. She stated her goal is to utilize the tournament to prepare effectively for the upcoming Women's Asia Cup. Sharma aims to make the most of the experience to improve her game before the continental championship.
